author: cli
text: Re-read at 0.56.0. The visitor's comments - annotation-assisted typing, the imported-name qualification, the event conventions - all still describe what it does. The one change is that the scope stack reads qual_of instead of rebuilding the qualname, so the call attribution uses the SAME numbering as the entity walk; that is what stopped a call in the third same-named def being credited to the first.

author: cli
text: Re-read at 0.57.2. The scope/var_types machinery and every comment about it are unchanged and still accurate; this staled because the visitor's call emission gained the `bare` field. See the confirm on visit_Call for why `bare` and `via_attr` must stay separate.
